queryInfo.statement: SELECT lookup(event.toucher,abbrevName) AS toucher,lookup(event.passer,abbrevName) AS passer,lookup(event.receiver,abbrevName) AS receiver,lookup(event.shooter,abbrevName) AS shooter,lookup(event.goalie,abbrevName) AS goalie,lookup(event.assister,abbrevName) AS assister,lookup(event.blocker,abbrevName) AS blocker,event.shooterPlayerId AS shooterId,event.assisterPlayerId AS assisterId,event.blockerPlayerId AS blockerId,event.receiverPlayerId AS receiverId,event.passerPlayerId AS passerId,event.toucherPlayerId AS toucherId,event.goaliePlayerId AS goalieId,game.gameId,game.espnEventId,game.optaMatchId,game.gameId+':'+event.gameEventIndex as eventGuid,event.gameEventIndex,event.sequenceId,event.remoteEventsPhaseId as phaseId,event.sequenceEventNum,event.possessionSeqNum,event.possessionNumInPeriod,event.playType,event.period,event.gameClock,event.sequenceSeconds,event.possessionSeconds,team.abbrevName as eventTeamAbbrevName,teamId,optaTeamId as teamImageId,newest(team.game.fullName) as teamFullName,newest(team.game.fullName) AS team,newest(team.game.abbrevName) as teamAbbrevName,newest(team.game.shortName) as teamShortName,newest(team.game.teamColor) as newestTeamColor,team.game.optaTeamId,format("date","yyyy-MM-dd",game.gameDate) as date,if(team.game.home,team.game.fullName,opponent.game.fullName) as homeTeam,if(team.game.home,opponent.game.fullName,team.game.fullName) as awayTeam,if(team.game.home,team.event.currentScore,opponent.event.currentScore) as homeCurrentScore,if(team.game.home,opponent.event.currentScore,team.event.currentScore) as awayCurrentScore,team.game.abbrevName as teamAbbrevName,team.game.abbrevName as team,newest(team.game.teamId) AS teamId,newest(team.game.optaTeamId) AS teamImageId,opponent.game.abbrevName as opponent,newest(opponent.game.teamId) AS opponentId,newest(opponent.game.optaTeamId) AS opponentTeamImageId,team.event.currentScoreOpponent as opponentCurrentScore,team.event.currentScore as teamCurrentScore,if(team.game.home,team.game.finalScore,opponent.game.finalScore) as homeFinalScore,if(team.game.home,opponent.game.finalScore,team.game.finalScore) as awayFinalScore,team.game.finalScore as teamFinalScore,opponent.game.finalScore as opponentFinalScore,game.numberOfPeriods ,game.periodLength ,game.gameDate,game.numberOfPeriods,game.periodLength,if(team.game.win,'W',if(team.game.loss,'L','T')) + ' ' + team.game.finalScore + '-' + team.game.finalScoreOpponent as result,team.event.currentScore + '-' + team.event.currentScoreOpponent as scoreAtTime,[xG|EVENT],[xA|EVENT],[ShotDist|EVENT], 'null-224' as reportId FROM team BY event WHERE ((team.teamId ='3kibouup3gxwnnxp3vhz83af7') AND ((event.primary AND event.playType IN ('CLEARANCE', 'TACKLE', 'INTERCEPTION', 'CHALLENGE', 'AERIAL', 'OFFSIDEPROVOKED', 'BLOCKEDPASS', 'SWEEPER', 'SHIELD', 'SAVE', 'ERROR', 'BALLRECOVERY')))) AND ((season.seasonId IN ('c1yslf7aazs430di8dpm8yvx0'))) ORDER BY game.gameDate DESC , game.gameId DEFAULT , event.gameEventIndex DEFAULT  LIMIT 100000
